(na)༄༅/ /'chi med tshe lha rnam gsum dril te sgrub pa'i rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga 'chi med rtag pa'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu

tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// 'chi med tshe lha rnam gsum dril te sgrub pa'i rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga 'chi med rtag pa'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru a mi tā bha ār+yā tā rā uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza yā bh+yaḥ gang mtshan rna bar lhung ba'i nyin byed kyis// 'chi med rtag pa'i pad+mo 'dzum pa'i gnyen// bla ma mchog dang gnyis med lhag pa'i lha// 'chi med lha mchog gsum gyis shis pa stsol// de yi rjes su gnang ba'i tshul// rje btsun bla ma'i gsung gi bcud// snying gi bum par bsti ba bzhin// ma 'khrul snying po bsdus te spel// 'di la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rdzes so// dang po ni/ gnas khang bkra shis shing dben la yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su tshe lha rnam gsum gyi snang brnyan bris 'bur ji ltar rigs pa bshams pa'i mdun/ stegs kyi khar mañdzi'i steng du maṇ+ḍa lar pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar zla gdan la tshom bu dkar po re bkod pa gsum bsgrig de'i g.yas g.yon rin po che'i snod du tshe ril dang tshe chang*/ mdun du gtor ma dkar zlum gsum/ mtha' skor du mtshams 'dzin me tog dang bcas pa'i chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril/ bum pa bcud ldan/ me tog gi snod/ slob ma la dgos pa'i maṇ+ḍal me tog nyer spyod lnga sogs sta gon bya'o// gnyis pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma la bya ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mchod pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis brlab/ dharmā ra ṇi ta lan gsum gyis byin dbab/ de nas skyabs yul spyi ltar gsal btab la/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das= dam pa'i chos= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes nyer gcig brjod mthar skyabs yul rnams rang la bstim/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'chi med tshe lha rnam gsum gyi sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ rang skad cig gis tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i a dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das 'chi med tshe'i lha mchog gsum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na ma ā yurde ba ga ṇa sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ oṃ ā yurde ba ga ṇa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i stong par bsams la/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa sum bsgrigs kyi lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de'i steng du rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo dbus su a dkar po/ g.yas su bh+rūm̐ dkar po/ g.yon du tām̐ yig dkar po/ de rnams la sems zhugs pa bzhin byas pas de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/

sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las dbus su rang nyid bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa gzi brjid kyi rgyal po sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa kha rgyan dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ spyan dkyus ring ba'i spyan gnyis zim bur gzigs shing zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas mdzes pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyel krung gis bzhugs pa/ sna tshogs pa'i 'od dkor mang pos bskor zhing 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ g.yas su bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gsum phyag brgyad/ dbus zhal dkar zhing sgeg pa/ g.yas zhal ser po zhi ba/ g.yon zhal sngon po khros pa/ mche bas ma mchu mnan pa/ zhal re re zhing spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos thugs kar sna tshogs rdo rje/ gnyis pas pad+ma la sangs rgyas 'od dpag med bzhugs pa/ gsum pas mda'/ bzhi pa mchog sbyin/ g.yon gyi dang pos sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ gnyis pas gzhu/ gsum pas skyabs sbyin/ bzhi pas bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams pa/ lang tsho gzhon zhing phun sum tshogs pa/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan zhing*/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang lha'i dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs mdzes pa/ tshe dpag tu med pa/ ston zla'i 'od lta bu'i 'od zer stong gi phreng ba can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis mchod rten gyi nang du bzhugs pa/ g.yon du rje btsun ma sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas mchog sbyin/

g.yon mtheb srin gyis ut+pal dkar po thugs kar bsnams pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs mnabs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i ngang tshul can/ dbu skra mthon mthing ltar gnag pa ltag par bcings pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rab tu dgyes pa'i spyan bdun dang ldan pa/ sku las 'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing*/ thugs kar zla ba la 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte ba la tāṃ yig dkar pos mtshan pa/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'chi med tshe lha rnam gsum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las tshe dpag med dang*/ sgrol ma la 'od dpag med/ rnam par rgyal ma la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ ā yurde ba ga ṇa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med// dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal// mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs// sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ma'i sku// ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma// rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// tut+tā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol// tu res na ba rnams las sgrol// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/

lha'i sku snang stong dbyer med la sems gtad de ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par bzhag de nas bzlas pa bya bar 'dod pas/ lha so so'i thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang rang gi sa bon gyi mthar rang sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal dang sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes thams cad rgyas par byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs rnams tshur bsdus rang la thim pas rang gi tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes thams cad rgyas par gyur par bsams la rim par dmigs te/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nyā na su bi nish+tsita te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ puṇ+ye puṇ+ye/ ma hā puṇ+ye/ a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ye/ a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ya dz+nyā na saṃ bha ro pa tsi te/ oṃ sarba saṃ skā ra pa ri shud+dha dharmā te ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā ba bi shud+dhe ma hā nā ya pa ri wā re swā hā/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ a mṛ ta ā yurda de swā hā/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re ma ma ā yuḥpuṇ+ye dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ rnams brgya rtsa sogs mi tshig gis bar ma chod par bzla/ phan yon ji skad gsungs pa rnams la nges shes dang gus pa bskyed/ thun gyi mthar/ bdag gi snying ga nas ye shes pa rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur par bsams la/ de la gong ltar mchod bstod bya/ bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ g.yas g.yon gyi dam tshig pa rang la thim/ zhes brjod/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs nas/

dbur brgyan par gong bdag bskyed ltar la/ rang nyid ces par de nyid ces 'don pa bsgyur/ mchod pa kha gsos la byin brlab/ dngos su 'byor dang yid las byung ba yi// rab 'byams zhing kun khyab pa'i mchod yon tshogs// bla ma 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'bul// bzhes nas tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol// oṃ ā yurde ba ga ṇa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes zhabs bsil nas/ rol mo'i bar sbyar ba'am/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyis mchod/ dril gsil dang bcas/ spro na mchod chog nas 'byung ba'i lha gsum gyi bstod pa tshig thung rnams dang*/ mi nus na gong ltar bstod/ de nas lnga tshan lnga'i bcud dang ldan pa'i bum pa'i khar dung chos dri bzang gi chus gang ba'i steng gzungs thag rdo rje bzhag la/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa dkris shing*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i nang du pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa sum bsgrigs kyi lte bar nas/ dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar dang*/ de la mchod bstod bcas gong bdag bskyed ltar byas la/ gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ bum nang gi lha so so'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa gsal btab/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song bas bum nang gi lha rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa dang*/ sku'i cha shas thams cad nas kyang bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa babs pas bum pa gang bar mos la sngags rnams brgya'am nyer gcig las mi nyung bar bzlas la gong ltar mchod cing bstod/

'dod don gsol gdab bya/ yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis lhag chad bskangs zhing bzod par gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ gtor ma chab kyis bran la bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma lha'i bdud rtsi kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis brlab/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ rang rang gi sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pa bdun nam lngas phul/ oṃ ā yurde ba ga ṇa sogs sbyar bas mchod cing bstod/ 'dod don gsol gdab gong bzhin bya/ mdun bskyed kyi lha so so'i thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang rang gi sa bon gyi mthar dang sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal dang sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshe dang bsod nams ye shes thams cad rgyas par byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs thams cad tshur 'dus/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar thim par bsams la sngags gsum po ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar 'dod don la gsol ba gdab bo// gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba ni/ dbang gis smin cing snod dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams khrus byas/ phyag dang yon phul te rang rang gi gral la snyim pa me tog dang bcas te 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sogs kun slong dang kun spyod gsal 'debs sngon du 'gro bas/ nges 'byung dang byang chub sems kyi gtam ci rigs pa dang*/ bshad bya'i chos mdo sngags kyi bye brag rgyud sde'i dbye bsdu sogs ji ltar 'tshams pa bshad rjes/

lo rgyus kyi khyad par/ da lam 'dir skabs su babs pa ni/ slob dpon chen po ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ chos spyod dbang po thul ba ni// 'khor ba ru ni ji srid gnas// de srid bsod nams la sogs tshogs// byang chub sgrub byed rab tu skye// 'khor bar srog las gces pa ni// ci yang yod pa ma mthong ste// de bas myur du thabs mang pos// 'chi ba slu ba kun tu spyad// ces gsungs pa ltar chos sgrub pa'i dal 'byor gyi lus rten yun ring du 'tsho ba'i thabs tshul lhur len pa shin tu gal che ba yin zhing*/ de la'ang*/ lus dang ngag gi las kyis phyi// bsam gtan las kyis nang gi yin/ nor bu sman sogs phyi yin te// rnal 'byor nus pa nang gi'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar phyi nor bu rin po che'i rigs dang bcud len gyi sman sbyor sogs la brten pa dang*/ nang rnal 'byor pa'i bsam gtan gyi nus pas tshe sring ba'i thabs gnyis su yod pa las/ 'dir nang gi rnal 'byor mchog tu gyur pa mtshan 'dzin pa'am/ sku'i snang brnyan dran pa tsam gyis kyang dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las skyob cing*/ tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes sogs gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa la brten nas mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yang dka' ba med par 'thob nus pa'i lhag pa'i lha khyad pa can 'chi med tshe lha rnam gsum ste/ de'ang tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i mdo mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i gzungs kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po mi tra dzo ki zhe bya ba dgung lo stong phrag gnyis lhag tsam bzhugs par grags pa de nyid kyis bkral ba bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa gzi brjid kyi rgyal po dang*/ rje btsun lho brag pa chen po mar pa lo tsā'i bka' srol las byon pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma dang*/

snying rje chen po ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags nas brgyud pa'i tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo ste de lta bu'i 'chi med tshe lha rnam gsum gcig tu dril ba'i rjes su gnang ba 'di ni/ spyir ring brgyud bar ma chad pa so so'i bka' srol las byon pa dang*/ nye brgyud bka' babs bdun gyi mnga' bdag kun mkhyen bla ma 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po la lhag pa'i lha so sos byin rlabs dngos su stsal ba la brten rjes su gnang ba phyogs gcig tu stsal ba'i phyag len gyi rim pa ma nyams par bsgrub par bgyi ba la slob dpon gyi bgyi bar 'os pa rnams legs par grub zin nas/ da khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la'ang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba'i rim pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab pa/ rgyud dag par bya ba/ khyad par gyi gsol ba 'debs pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ thog mar slob dpon la mgon po tshe dpag med dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas phyag snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'chi med lha mchog gsum la gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin phung chen po 'thibs pa bzhin mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par mos pa byas te/ de dag gi spyan sngar bdag gzhan gyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// nas 'grub par shog ces rgyud dag par byas nas/ slar yang khyad par gyi don zhu ba'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po ches/ bdag gi dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bsal nas bcom ldan 'das 'chi med lha mchog gsum gyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes pa rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la thog mar rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du/ slob dpon la mgon po tshe dpag med dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus drag po dung pa zhig byas pa'i rkyen gyis/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bag chags dang bcas pa dang*/ der ma zad rnam smin gdos bcas sha khrag gis bsdus pa'i phung po khams dang skye mched sogs ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ swa bhā ba sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa sum bsgrigs kyi lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de'i steng du khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo dbus su a dkar po g.yas su bh+rūm̐ dkar po/ g.yon du tām̐ yig dkar po/ de rnams la sems zhugs pa bzhin cher gyis gtad pas de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las dbus su bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sogs nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i dbus su rang rang gi sa bon rnams gsal btab nas/

slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa mdun bskyed dang*/ phyog bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ steng phyogs 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan dpag tu med pa la sogs pa rang bzhin gyi gnas na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thugs kar phog de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa la/ rnam pa bcom ldan 'das 'chi med tshe'i lha gsum gyi sku tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib kyis thim pas thugs ka'i sa bon rnams las kyang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa skya chil chil babs/ lus thams cad 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis khengs pas/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sangs kyis dag tshe dang bsod nams ye shes dang yon tan la sogs pa thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur pa'i thugs nges brtan po gnang ba zhu/ sngags gsum dril nas so so'i mthar dz+nyā na ā we sha ya ā āḥ btags pa lan gsum re/ mthar dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes lan gsum brjod/ spos rol bya/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas skur byed nam mkha'i lha tshogs spyan drangs pa la khyed rang rnams kyis yan lag bzhi pa sgrub pa'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas bum pa 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba de thogs nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/

dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ sngags rnams kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las so so'i rigs kyi bdag pos dbur brgyan/ slob dpon gyis/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyang khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar khyed rang rnams 'chi med lha mchog rnam gsum gyi skur bskyed cing byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid la mnga' dbul gyi slad du me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis kyang mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas nai bi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gi bar phyag rgya dang bcas pa bya zhing las rdor gyis mchod pa stob pa'i tshul bya/ slar yang slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pas me tog gi char 'bebs shing bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pas kyang mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas me tog 'thor bzhin du/ phun sum tshogs pa nas/ bkra shis gsum pa'o// zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de ltar na 'chi med tshe lha rnam gsum gyi sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ gnas skabs su lus lha'i skur bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ mthar thug 'chi med tshe lha rnam gsum gyi sku dang dbyer med par byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du thugs mos mdzod/ rjes gnang dngos la lung gsum las/ thog mar rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gzungs sngags kyi phreng ba dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byung*/

slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon a bh+rūm̐ tām̐ yig rnams kyi mthar g.yas skor gyi 'khod par mos nas me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ ces dang*/ lha gsum gyi gzungs dang snying po rnams bzlar gzhug de ltar lan gsum bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos te/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor zhing*/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog phreng ba sngags su byas te/ khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la bcom ldan 'das 'chi med tshe lha rnam gsum gyi gzungs sngags dang rig sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog gtor/ dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du/ dus da nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/ bcom ldan 'das 'chi med tshe lha rnam gsum yi dam gyi lhar gzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag rig pa 'dzin pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du bcom ldan 'das 'chi med tshe lha rnam gsum yi dam gyi lhar gzung bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ de ltar na 'chi med tshe lha gsum gyi gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/

gnas skabs su ngag sngags bzla ba la dbang zhing*/ mthar thug 'chi med tshe lha gsum gyi gsung dang dbyer med par byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das 'chi med tshe lha gsum gyi sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam par thugs ka nas rgyangs kyis bye nas byon pa khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim/ thugs ka'i sa bon rnams dang dbyer med du gyur par mos pa bya/ de'i ngang las lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la yid cher gyis gtad pas g.yas g.yon gyi lha gnyis 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang nyid la thim/ rang nyid lha sku gdan dang bcas pa 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te/ thugs ka'i sa bon a yig la thim/ a de'ang je chung je phrar gyur te mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur pa la brten nas/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu rgyud la skyes par mos pa byas te cung zad cig mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de ltar na 'chi med tshe lha gsum gyi thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob/ khyed rang rnams kyi yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ gnas skabs su yid 'od gsal gyi ye shes su bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ mthar thug 'chi med tshe lha gsum gyi thugs dang dbyer med par byin gyis brlab pa yin snyam du thugs mos mdzod/ slar yang khyed rang rnams 'chi med lha mchog gsum gyi skur lam gyis gsal ba la rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i mtha' rten du sku tshe rab tu brtan cing zhal bsro ba'i slad du 'khor 'das kyi dwangs bcud thams cad 'dus pa'i 'chi med tshe'i ril bu dang*/

bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags gsum bzla bzhin sbyin/ de nyid la slob dpon mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis me tog gi char phab cing bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs sh+lo ka gsum dang*/ lo brgya thub cing*/ 'chi med tshe yi dpal sogs brjod/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi mtha' rten dang bcas pa legs par grub pas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la srung sdom bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum/ zhes dam tshig 'dzin par khas blangs nas/ rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal dbul du bcug de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul ba ma zad lus longs spyod rnams kyang slob dpon la 'bul na/ cha shas nas bzhes la longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs lan gsum/ de rnams kyi sgo nas 'chi med tshe lha gsum gyi rjes su gnang ba 'jam dbyangs bla ma mchog gi zhal snga nas ji ltar stsal ba'i lugs bzhin phul grub pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad pa dang*/ dge rtsa byang chub snying por yongs su bsngo bas rgyas 'debs pa zhu/ zhes dang*/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang*/ gsum pa ni/ mchod pa kha gsos nas byin gyis brlab/ gong ltar mchod bstod gsol ba btab nas/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad sogs nas/ 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas mtheb srin gyis se gol dang*/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par aḥ thugs kar hūm̐/

dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /tshe dpag med mgon 'grub gyur sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam dang*/ che ba'i che mchog sogs brjod cing me tog gis phyogs kun tu 'thor bas bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// 'chi med lha mchog rnam gsum gyi// sgrub rjes snying por dril ba'i dges// bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan bdag sogs 'gro// dus min 'chi las rgyal gyur cig /ces 'chi med tshe lha rnam gsum dril te sgrub pa'i rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga 'chi med rtag pa'i thig le zhes bya ba 'di ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rje bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zhabs de nyid kyi bka'i rjes su gnang ba thob par brten 'di'i rjes gnang stsal skabs kyi zin tho ji lta bar yig cha rnams mtshams sbyor gyis brgyan te blo gter dbang pos gsal bar bkod pa maṅga laṃ ma ra sid+dhir+bha ba tā// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
